question_patterns: why is there sand at the beach
en.first_sentence: Sand is made of tiny bits of rock.
facts: Wind and water slowly break big rocks apart.
The bits get smaller and smaller until they are sand.
Sand is mostly found on beaches and in deserts.
en.ask_back: Is sand ground-up rock, or turned-up sugar?
